name: DWH MetaModule Contract
purpose: define MetaModule as one canonical semantic kind composable from reusable semantics without creating application-specific runtimes

identity.rule: every machine-significant MetaModule has one stable canonical identity

classification.rule: placement answers where the MetaModule belongs; placement does not create a new base type

mustNot: create a separate runtime solely because the business/domain label differs
composition.rule: new applications are formed by composition over shared semantic primitives

dwhRole: store/resolve canonical MetaModule identity and relations
project MetaModule views without creating duplicate authority

eventCoverage.rule: missing Event evidence does not invalidate an otherwise structurally representable MetaModule; Events are reviewed separately and must never be invented to fill coverage

invariants: MetaModule is semantic composition, not a runtime implementation
Universal semantics remain owned by their Universal definitions
Composition may add domain-specific relations/rules/operations without redefining consumed Universals
same canonical MetaModule may have multiple projections and Expose surfaces
Expose presence does not create a second MetaModule identity
implementation language does not change semantic identity
